liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodleloo** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this their favorite version, noting its length and chills; Jerry's solo is described as wailing and the all-time definitive version [10][12]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Band shifts into overdrive after a pause in the first solo [19]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Jerry's solo becomes a memorable march; transition to Saint Stephen is chilling [15]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Reviewer calls this the best ever, with a raw and chunky jam [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-11-06.122296.sbd.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 166 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd77-11-06.sbd.nawrocki.283.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 166 min; rated 4.3/5 by 79 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound shifts from 1977 ooze to next-gen rock; songs from MNS on are top shelf [17]
- **gd77-11-06.moore.cribbs.16758.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 170 min; rated 4/5 by 16 [5]. Said about its sound: Mix is sharp from the opener through the entire encore [18]
- **gd1977-11-06.148412.1st.set.fob.shure.sm57.sublette.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 12 songs; 89 min [7]

## Around the show

- Surprised people prefer this over the previous night; Garcia misses melody but raves [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-11-06.122296.sbd.flac16**: source: MR>PCM>DAT>HD>CDR>EAC>Flac level 8 via TLH [1]. Also: From original TDK baby blue 4X CDRs burned by the DAT converter [1]
- **gd77-11-06.sbd.nawrocki.283.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Source lineage includes SBD, MR, PCM, DAT, and CDR formats [9]
- **gd77-11-06.moore.cribbs.16758.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by David Minches; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM-33Ps [5]
- **gd1977-11-06.148412.1st.set.fob.shure.sm57.sublette.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Kathy Sublette; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Kathy Sublette's Master (FOB) Audience Cassette; Shure SM57 mics > Sony-TC158 [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1977-11-06 Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1977-11-06-ticket/) [22]
